brief_rationale: The doctor completed all eight responsibility-chain duties without any serious or minor error. In addition, the model actively discovered hidden context (prior childhood fainting history and exact discharge diagnosis wording) beyond the minimum Holter-closure requirement, and corrected the caregiver's misconception merging '体位性低血压/心动过快' with oral rehydration salts. These two high-order achievements had meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying Perfect. No important non-chain defect exists, and closure is valid, safe, and traceable.
